description: Search the text of Iranian statutes and regulations (قوانین و مقررات) published by Dadras and get the best-matching articles, each with an excerpt of its text, a note when it is repealed or old, and its dadrasai.com link. Use it for a question about what Iranian law says on a subject — «شرایط فسخ قرارداد اجاره», «مجازات کلاهبرداری» — or to check an article's wording before quoting it. Not for reading one known article in full (get_law_article), finding a law by its name (find_law), a word's meaning (explain_legal_term) or an amount (the calculate_* tools). Covers statutes and regulations only, not court rulings. Candidates are ordered by a legal relevance model; an article named by number and law comes first. Works best in Persian, in the statute's own vocabulary rather than as a story.

limit.description: How many articles to return (1–8); 5 when not given.

query.description: A Persian search phrase of a few words — the legal subject («حضانت فرزند پس از طلاق») or an article («ماده ۱۰ قانون مدنی»); English works less well.

name: search_iranian_law

links.description: The dadrasai.com pages the result cites, in order.

text.description: The result, in Persian, as it should be quoted.

title: Search Iranian law (دادرس)
